description: A floor-length plum-purple opaque gown with low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Broad gold woven borders decorate the neckline, front, sleeve hems and skirt hem; round gold shoulder brooches and a waist belt of linked gold discs are visible. A cream woven wrap with gold/purple borders rests around both forearms and hangs beside the skirt. Closed patterned flat shoes are visible at the hem. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
